findings.desc: doc-code-drift: Phase-1 rebrand plan (CHK-001) says replace capitalized brand word Lattice in prose, but the compound adjective Lattice-native was left unchanged in multiple in-scope doc files. README.md:374 has Lattice-native planner surface; docs/guide.md:134 has Lattice-native planner entry point; docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-authority-live-integration.md has the section heading ## Stage C Requirements: Lattice-Native Planner (line 1960), body text Stage C must be Lattice-native (line 1965), and diagram labels -> Lattice-native Story Planner / -> Lattice-native Job Planner (lines 592, 594, 3514, 3515). In the same sentences where other Lattice->Proofbound replacements were applied, these Lattice-native compounds were skipped.
